_comment: Narration lexicon (natural-sounding-narration-with-frankentts). Nothing is respelled and nothing has been probed or listened to; these are the risks to probe, each in its real sentence against a control and a decoy, before that line is synthesized. Root performs the bounded route probe; the owner's pronunciation overrides every source. Active script (chapter 01): 'minute' and 'minutes' are the time noun (MIN-it), never the adjective 'my-NEWT' (01_2, 01_5, 01_6; the full draft says them 74 times); 'route' in 01_2 needs the owner's choice of 'root' or 'rowt' (said once, in 'Two bus routes'); 'weekday' (01_1); 'Four minutes and twenty seconds' and 'an extra minute and twenty seconds' (01_6) are durations, not clock times. Full draft only (docs/storyboard-draft.md): 'four twenty' and 'eight forty' said bare as durations (06_7, 'Behind you four twenty, ahead of you four twenty. Together, the eight forty of your gap'), which a voice may read as clock times or as two numbers; 'second' in 06_5 is the ordinal ('a second way') and in 10_6 the unit ('many times a second'); 'ten millisecond call' and 'two millisecond calls' (10_6, compound adjectives, singular 'millisecond'); the fractions 'five sixths' (02_6, 06_4), 'a sixth' (06_4), 'Four and a third' (04_7), 'Eight and two thirds' (10_4) and 'three and a third' (12_4); 'nineteen twenty-two' as a year (10_7); the names Feld and Grofman (Scott L. Feld, Bernard Grofman, 10_5; look up how each says his own name), the Japanese name Torahiko Terada (10_7; look it up, no English stress pattern assumed) and Tokyo (10_7). 'Headway', 'variance' and 'Poisson' are on cards only, never voiced.
